evals.name: visual-reference-to-instagram-carousel-style
evals.prompt: 我鍾意呢三張圖嘅視覺感覺，幫我拆出嚟，之後想用喺 IG Carousel。
evals.expected_output: A short natural Cantonese acknowledgement followed by visual Style extraction for the Instagram carousel destination. The assistant does not ask the student to choose a mode and does not create Tone or Skill candidates without supporting language or workflow evidence.
assertions: The first reply is brief, natural Hong Kong Cantonese and asks at most one material question
Auto routing selects the style layer and ig-carousel target use without exposing internal status codes
The candidate keeps STYLE.md and DESIGN.md separate from current copy, identity and campaign content
No Vault write, installation, generation or publication is implied

evals.name: mixed-reference-to-style-tone-and-skill
evals.prompt: 呢批資料有設計圖、caption 同埋作者示範點樣由資料做到貼文。幫我拆成可以重用嘅嘢。
evals.expected_output: Auto mode identifies supported visual, language and workflow signals, explains them in a three-row plain-language review, and creates candidate STYLE/DESIGN, TONE and SKILL/evals outputs only after evidence review.
assertions: The assistant routes by evidence inside the references rather than by file extension
Visual, language and workflow conclusions preserve separate evidence and do-not-copy boundaries
The Skill output remains a candidate with two normal scenarios and one hidden holdout
The assistant asks one combined review instead of three technical interviews

evals.name: single-attractive-output-does-not-prove-workflow
evals.prompt: 我得一張靚圖，幫我變成 Style、Tone 同 Skill。
evals.expected_output: A visual candidate may be proposed with uncertainty, but unsupported Tone and Skill layers are explicitly withheld. The assistant explains what more evidence would be needed in plain language.
assertions: The assistant does not force all three candidate layers
One image is not treated as proof of a repeatable workflow or writing Tone
Identity, exact copy, Logo and source claims are excluded from reusable rules
Only one next question is asked

evals.name: ordinary-summary-request-does-not-become-a-style-pack
evals.prompt: 幫我總結呢篇文章講咩。
evals.expected_output: The task is treated as an ordinary summary request, not as Style, Tone or Skill extraction. Image Style Lab should not claim candidates or create save routes.
assertions: No STYLE.md, TONE.md or SKILL.md candidate is created
No technical route receipt is shown to the user
No save or publication action is inferred
